_meta.description: Complete security hardening plan for SCS K3s cluster - October 2026
_meta.notes: Tasks are organized by priority. Start with P1-CRITICAL tasks first.

tasks.title: Change Grafana admin password to secure random password
tasks.accept: bash -c 'echo "Checking Grafana password change..." && test -f /home/weissto_local/.grafana_password && echo "Password file exists" && wc -c /home/weissto_local/.grafana_password | awk "{print \$1}"" | grep -q "[40-99]" && echo "Password appears secure" || echo "Password too short"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Grafana admin password changed from 'admin123' to a secure 48+ character random password, stored in .grafana_password file with 600 permissions

tasks.title: Enable K3s RBAC and backup existing configuration
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/ansible/roles/k3s/tasks/rbac.yml && echo "RBAC tasks exist" && grep -q "enable-admission-plugins.*PodSecurity" ../scs/ansible/roles/k3s/tasks/rbac.yml && echo "PodSecurity admission enabled" || echo "PodSecurity not found"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: K3s RBAC enabled with backup of existing configuration, admission plugins configured for PodSecurity

tasks.title: Apply Pod Security Standards baseline to all application namespaces
tasks.accept: bash -c 'for ns in opendesk opendesk-edu next-mailserver-test backup nix-builder monitoring argocd scs-infra; do kubectl get ns $ns -L pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=baseline 2>/dev/null && echo "$ns: baseline enabled" || echo "$ns: checking..."; done'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Pod Security Standards baseline enforced on all application namespaces via labels

tasks.title: Enable K3s audit logging with comprehensive policy
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/ansible/roles/k3s/templates/audit-policy.yaml.j2 && echo "Audit policy template exists" && grep -q "Metadata\|RequestResponse\|Request" ../scs/ansible/roles/k3s/templates/audit-policy.yaml.j2 && echo "Policy rules defined" || echo "Policy incomplete"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Audit logging enabled with policy covering secrets, configmaps, pods, deployments with appropriate log levels and retention

tasks.title: Enable LDAP authentication for Grafana
tasks.accept: bash -c 'grep -q "auth.ldap" ../scs/ansible/roles/grafana/templates/grafana.ini.j2 && echo "LDAP config found" || echo "LDAP config missing"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Grafana LDAP authentication configured with HRZ LDAP server settings

tasks.title: Create dedicated ServiceAccount and RBAC for ArgoCD
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/k8s/argocd/rbac.yaml && echo "RBAC file exists" && grep -q "ServiceAccount\|ClusterRole\|ClusterRoleBinding" ../scs/k8s/argocd/rbac.yaml && echo "RBAC resources defined"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: ArgoCD ServiceAccount created with least-privilege ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding, default service account permissions removed from ArgoCD namespace

tasks.title: Create dedicated ServiceAccounts for all application namespaces
tasks.accept: bash -c 'for ns in opendesk opendesk-edu next-mailserver-test backup nix-builder monitoring; do test -f ../scs/k8s/$ns/serviceaccount.yaml && echo "$ns: serviceaccount.yaml exists" || echo "$ns: missing"; done'
tasks.acceptance_prose: ServiceAccounts created for all application namespaces with appropriate RBAC roles

tasks.title: Create NetworkPolicies for system namespaces (kube-system, kube-public)
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/k8s/networkpolicies/kube-system.yaml && echo "kube-system NetworkPolicy exists" && grep -q "kind: NetworkPolicy" ../scs/k8s/networkpolicies/kube-system.yaml'
tasks.acceptance_prose: NetworkPolicies created for kube-system and kube-public namespaces restricting pod-to-pod communication

tasks.title: Enable TLS for Prometheus and Alertmanager
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/k8s/monitoring/prometheus-tls.yaml && echo "Prometheus TLS config exists" && grep -q "tls\.crt\|tls\.key" ../scs/k8s/monitoring/prometheus-tls.yaml'
tasks.acceptance_prose: TLS certificates generated and configured for Prometheus and Alertmanager with proper SAN entries

tasks.title: Harden containerd configuration for security
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/ansible/roles/containerd/templates/config.toml.j2 && echo "Config exists" && grep -q "no_pivot\|SystemdCgroup\|NoNewPrivileges" ../scs/ansible/roles/containerd/templates/config.toml.j2 && echo "Security options configured"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Containerd configuration hardened with security options: no_pivot, SystemdCgroup, NoNewPrivileges, disable_tcp_service

tasks.title: Create dedicated S3 user for backups (non-admin)
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/k8s/backup/seaweedfs-backup-user-secret.yaml && echo "Backup user secret exists" && grep -q "k8up-backup-user" ../scs/k8s/backup/seaweedfs-backup-user-secret.yaml'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Dedicated S3 user for K8up backups created with restricted permissions (read/write to k8up-backups bucket only)
tasks.notes: This requires TrueNAS admin access to create user on clrz12-02

tasks.title: Harden SSH configuration on all SCS nodes
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/ansible/roles/ssh_hardening/tasks/main.yml && echo "SSH hardening role exists" && grep -q "PermitRootLogin no\|PasswordAuthentication no\|MaxAuthTries" ../scs/ansible/roles/ssh_hardening/tasks/main.yml && echo "SSH hardening options configured"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: SSH configuration hardened: disable root login, disable password auth, limit auth tries, restrict allowed users

tasks.title: Apply CIS benchmark kernel parameters to all nodes
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/ansible/roles/kernel_hardening/templates/99-k3s-security.conf.j2 && echo "Config exists" && grep -q "net.ipv4\|kernel.kptr_restrict\|kernel.randomize_va_space" ../scs/ansible/roles/kernel_hardening/templates/99-k3s-security.conf.j2 && echo "Kernel parameters configured"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: CIS benchmark kernel parameters configured for network security, memory protection, and process isolation

tasks.title: Review and harden ArgoCD security configuration
tasks.accept: bash -c 'grep -q "rbac:\|ssos:\|dex\|oidc" ../scs/argocd/kustomization.yaml 2>/dev/null || grep -q "rbac:\|ssos" ../scs/argocd/app-argocd.yaml 2>/dev/null || echo "SSO/RBAC config needed"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: ArgoCD security reviewed: SSO/OAuth2 enabled, RBAC configured, deploy key permissions restricted, image signing enabled
tasks.notes: May require external identity provider configuration

tasks.title: Security review of Nix builder configuration
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/k8s/nix-builder/securitycontext.yaml && echo "Security context exists" && grep -q "runAsNonRoot\|readOnlyRootFilesystem\|allowPrivilegeEscalation" ../scs/k8s/nix-builder/securitycontext.yaml || echo "Security context needs review"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Nix builder security reviewed: runs as non-root, read-only filesystem, privilege escalation prevented, resource limits set

tasks.title: Create CA and certificate rotation process for SCS cluster
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/ansible/roles/certificates/tasks/main.yml && echo "Certificate role exists" && grep -q "openssl\|cfssl\|cert-manager" ../scs/ansible/roles/certificates/tasks/main.yml || echo "Certificate management needed"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Certificate Authority created for SCS cluster, certificate rotation process documented, cert-manager or equivalent deployed
tasks.notes: Consider using cert-manager or step-ca for certificate management

tasks.title: OS hardening for all SCS nodes (fail2ban, rkhunter, AIDE)
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/ansible/roles/os_hardening/tasks/main.yml && echo "OS hardening role exists" && grep -q "fail2ban\|rkhunter\|lynis\|aide" ../scs/ansible/roles/os_hardening/tasks/main.yml && echo "Security tools configured"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: OS hardening applied: fail2ban configured, rkhunter installed, lynis audits scheduled, AIDE file integrity monitoring enabled

tasks.title: Research and plan Zero Trust Networking implementation
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/docs/ZERO-TRUST-PLAN.md && echo "Zero Trust plan exists" && grep -q "mTLS\|service mesh\|identity-based\|Istio\|Linkerd" ../scs/docs/ZERO-TRUST-PLAN.md && echo "Implementation planned"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Zero Trust Networking plan created: service mesh selection (Istio/Linkerd), mTLS implementation, identity-based access control, phased rollout strategy

tasks.title: Deploy Falco or similar runtime security monitoring
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/k8s/security/falco.yaml && echo "Falco deployment exists" || echo "Runtime monitoring needed"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Runtime security monitoring deployed: Falco or equivalent with rules for suspicious activity detection, alerts configured

tasks.title: Deploy external secrets manager (Vault or Sealed Secrets)
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/k8s/security/sealed-secrets.yaml && echo "Sealed Secrets exists" || test -f ../scs/k8s/security/vault.yaml && echo "Vault exists" || echo "Secrets manager needed"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: External secrets manager deployed: Sealed Secrets or Vault with KMS integration, secret encryption at rest, rotation process

tasks.title: Enable MFA for all admin interfaces
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/docs/MFA-IMPLEMENTATION.md && echo "MFA plan exists" && grep -q "Grafana\|ArgoCD\|SSH\|TOTP\|WebAuthn" ../scs/docs/MFA-IMPLEMENTATION.md && echo "MFA configured for key services"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: MFA enabled for: SSH access, Grafana, ArgoCD, all admin interfaces with TOTP or WebAuthn

tasks.title: Create comprehensive Security Hardening documentation
tasks.accept: bash -c 'test -f ../scs/docs/SECURITY-HARDENING.md && wc -l ../scs/docs/SECURITY-HARDENING.md | awk "{print \$1}" | grep -q "[100-999]" && echo "Documentation comprehensive"'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Security Hardening documentation created with: current state assessment, hardening steps, verification commands, rollback procedures, maintenance schedule
